scope: Repository-declared API methods, FastAPI default metadata, Next pages/proxies, renderer HTTP, legacy widgets/authority, real thread launches plus explicitly reviewed execution/storage boundaries. Not a production exposure scan or runtime authorization policy.

public.metadata.observed: Открытые metadata/education endpoints; личная AuthN не заявлена.
public.metadata.target: Явный public allowlist; безопасная проекция, лимит ответа и throttle для compute.

ops.diagnostics.observed: /health/ops без AuthN; безопасная проекция технического состояния.
ops.diagnostics.target: Private ops/service или platform permission; не раскрывать конфигурацию/секреты.

api.key.observed: AUTH-03 get_current_principal/require_api_key project one RequestContext; legacy ENV or verified UUID Account binding; invalid/presented credential never falls back to cookie. No can_use_api/CU admission yet.
api.key.target: Valid account-bound API credential + scopes + can_use_api + object/stage/atomic budgets.

api.model_key.observed: AUTH-08 durable Account-effective capabilities from current RequestContext; platform role never upgrades a bound Account. Unbound ENV staff adapter remains until AUTH-10. Existing can_train_models guards retained; comprehensive operation/object/budget admission remains AUTH-09/11/12.
api.model_key.target: Operation/model-aware split baseline/tune/custom, API/account scopes, atomic compute reservation.

browser.internal.observed: Нет общей AuthN dependency; данные тела/исследовательская cookie не личный вход.
browser.internal.target: Unified authenticated context, object/stage/capability/grant checks; CSRF mutations; same direct-API policy.

browser.session.observed: AnalysisSession по cisstat_session_id; общей личной AuthN, Account/CU admission нет. AUTH-09 central session_pointer validates current context and durable run before scientific data; unknown pointer rotated; legacy data never auto-claimed; authority failure 503.
browser.session.target: AuthSession отдельно от research pointer; account object policy + stage/grant/budget на каждом входе.

progress.session.observed: Research session + существующие trace/delivery/mirror guards; не личная AuthN.
progress.session.target: Unified account context; сохранить object/mirror проверки, ограничить admission/observations.

run.object.observed: AUTH-03 shared context subject projection + existing authorize_run_access owner/tenant/unresolved continuity; incompatible credentials/research owner rejected before object gate. Legacy ADMIN object bypass remains AUTH-09. AUTH-09: explicit Account/tenant boundary before ADMIN/dev/creator cookie; owner_subject provenance. Named legacy write requires migration.
run.object.target: Authenticated account context + current tenant/object permission; uniform 404; controlled legacy migration.

admin.key.observed: AUTH-03 shared request context with AUTH-07 migration: named admin session (auth_session) requires platform_role=admin AND mfa_verified_at (403 admin_role_required/mfa_required otherwise); ADMIN API-key stays as programmatic channel until AUTH-10; missing/invalid credential 401, unavailable authority 503.
admin.key.target: Named platform-admin permission + fresh MFA + scoped action + mandatory audit where sensitive.

document.object.observed: Existing document object/scopes/lifecycle policy consumes AUTH-03 shared context; legacy session surrogate only outside scoped mode. Account ownership bridge remains AUTH-09. AUTH-09 common run gate enforces Account/tenant before role/dev compatibility; original author remains provenance. Lazy visual freeze uses actual caller.
document.object.target: Same unified account-aware object authority for metadata, preview, content, jobs and lifecycle; no ID-as-permission.

profile.policy.observed: AUTH-03 shared context subject + existing OrgProfileService policy.admin/mandatory audit. Named MFA policy remains AUTH-05/07.
profile.policy.target: Unified context + explicit policy admin permission/MFA; preserve tenant and mandatory transaction semantics.

logs.scoped.observed: Manual compatibility adapter now passes the real Request into AUTH-03 coordinator; same invalid-key/ambiguity/authority semantics; scopes/SupportGrant exact-pair policy retained.
logs.scoped.target: Unified AuthN without losing exact tenant/run/action pairs; admin MFA and support scope policy; secret-safe exports.

renderer.service.observed: No HTTP credential check; intended isolated sandbox, body/timeout/concurrency and output constraints.
renderer.service.target: Private service boundary + authenticated authorized caller/operation context; revoke/budget before job start and output.

proxy.transport.observed: AUTH-06 shared force-dynamic Node proxy: fixed TLS target, exact configured Origin/Fetch Metadata/CSRF before forwarding, generated method/path allowlist, identity/forwarded headers stripped, explicit cookie/header forwarding, no redirect/no-store. Backend remains authority. GET restore blocked.
proxy.transport.target: Scientific ownership/enforcement remains AUTH-09/11; maintain reviewed allowlist.

ui.page.observed: Page component/navigation/redirect, no common personal AuthN gate; UI is not an authority.
ui.page.target: UI handles auth/denial/account switch; backend independently enforces operation policy.

ui.admin.observed: AUTH-07: common admin UI in both shells (/admin, /admin/progress, /admin/logs; AdminGate + session-based dashboards, no browser API-key); named session checked via /api/v1/auth/me, final role/MFA enforcement server-side.
ui.admin.target: Named ADMIN+MFA and common admin UI in both shells; OWNER/analyst cannot elevate by URL.

legacy.token.observed: Legacy shared-token entry + session_state.authenticated gate; pre-auth form отдельно отмечена в resource/effects. Не личная Account authority.
legacy.token.target: Explicit isolation/decommission or migrate to common AuthN/object/capability/budget controls; no paid/demo bypass.

worker.authority.observed: In-process worker trusts queued durable work/admission; not a browser-authenticated request.
worker.authority.target: Service credential/context where remote; recheck account/grant/revoke/reservation/deadline, fence settle/publication.

storage.internal.observed: Internal file/object/DB operation; content hash/path/registry checks are not user authentication.
storage.internal.target: Reach only via authorized object service; trusted roots/keys, no direct filesystem mount or public object ACL.

cors.transport.observed: AUTH-06 exact explicit HTTPS origins; no wildcard preview or implicit localhost credentials. CORS is not AuthN.
cors.transport.target: Scientific direct API authority rollout remains AUTH-11.

task.alias.observed: Four UI application hrefs; causes has live backend data, other task views do not imply ready compute.
task.alias.target: Canonical application-stage gate including aliases; scientific EDA Granger/DOCLOG monitoring are distinct.

auth.storage.observed: AUTH-02/04/05 PostgreSQL authority and audit outbox. AUTH-08 operator-only Account/membership lifecycle serializes Account CAS, scoped terminal session/challenge invalidation and mandatory audit intent; no new schema or public seat/plan assignment. No memory auth fallback. AUTH-09 trusted single-run migration locks Account→run→session, requires expected source/version/evidence and common PostgreSQL relations; immutable receipt and existing audit outbox commit together.
auth.storage.target: Only trusted coordinator may call; verify role/MFA/membership/account and transactional audit before mutations. No public tenant/plan assignment or memory fallback.

auth.entry.observed: AUTH-04 explicit HTTPS cookie entry: CSRF issuance or password proof + account membership. Signed host-only CSRF, rate/hash bounds, no password-only ADMIN session; safe 422/no-store. AUTH-05 named ADMIN password proof yields enrollment/login challenge only; no full session before MFA. AUTH-08 selects only active, unexpired Accounts and rechecks half-open Account expiry in session/MFA verification.
auth.entry.target: Preserve entry/challenge distinction; MFA AUTH-05, full proxy/UI AUTH-06, OIDC AUTH-19. No caller-supplied identity authority.

auth.session.observed: AUTH-04 opaque PostgreSQL session, online expiry/credential/subject/epoch/membership checks; self-only session/password commands; CSRF on mutation; audit intent atomic with state. AUTH-05 sessions require current MFA factor for ADMIN; MFA evidence only from confirmed local TOTP. AUTH-06 safe generated me DTO; optional account selection after password proof, no session for account choices. AUTH-08 enforces Account expiry and current entitlements; me exposes effective capabilities without role-derived upgrade.
auth.session.target: Effective Account entitlements/ownership, common proxy and named admin rollout remain AUTH-06/07/08/09/11/20.

auth.mfa.entry.observed: AUTH-05 CSRF+exact Origin; opaque purpose-bound PostgreSQL single-use challenge, 5m expiry, 5 attempts plus subject-wide limiter; current identity/credential/epoch/account membership checked; TOTP replay fence, recovery revokes all sessions; mandatory audit intent atomic. Challenge never authorizes protected API. Pending recovery login remains a recovery-only challenge; another unused code can resume a lost response; password alone cannot restart enrollment.
auth.mfa.entry.target: First-party proxy/login UX and named browser admin route rollout in AUTH-06/07; WebAuthn UV preferred future adapter; current local fallback TOTP.

auth.mfa.session.observed: AUTH-05 online AuthSession+CSRF+Origin; password+TOTP step-up proof scoped to exact session/action, single-use and 5m; replacement/recovery rotation consume proof atomically with mandatory audit. MFA-session password change also requires password.change proof. AUTH-08 enforces Account expiry and current entitlements; me exposes effective capabilities without role-derived upgrade.
auth.mfa.session.target: Extend action catalogue only alongside guarded sensitive admin APIs in AUTH-07; no client MFA assertions.

ui.login.observed: AUTH-06 shared personal login/MFA/recovery and safe generated me DTO; no token URL/storage, exact local return_to, top-level login for framed context. API authority mandatory.
ui.login.target: Named admin pages and account lifecycle remain AUTH-07/08.
